query:
select least((date_trunc('month', $1::date) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date,
                        (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bishkek')::date) as "d!",
                  date_trunc('month', $1::date) > date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Asia/Bishkek')
                    as "future!"
